verdict.rationale: TeamViewer does ship automations: remote script execution, automated remediation, and Tia building automations. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back those automations is therefore a fair question for this product, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents version history, change review, or rollback for scripts or automations. The audit log is an adjacent control, not automation versioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
